# Amherstburg Heating & Cooling

> Amherstburg Heating & Cooling is a local HVAC company serving Amherstburg, Essex County, Ontario, offering furnace repair, AC repair, ductless mini-split installation, heat pump repair and installation, fireplace installation, thermostat repair, and duct cleaning to homeowners across the region.

Service areas: Amherstburg, Windsor, LaSalle, Tecumseh, Leamington, Lakeshore, Belle River, Essex
